Package com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.infrastructure.resourceserver

Record Class ServiceClientAuthProperties

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.irurueta.authserver.serviceclient.infrastructure.resourceserver.ServiceClientAuthProperties
Record Components:
method - how the client authenticates, client_secret_basic by default.
clientId - identifier of the client, service-client by default.
clientSecret - shared secret of client_secret_basic; empty for the other methods.
tokenUri - token endpoint, http://localhost:9000/oauth2/token by default.
scopes - scopes requested, documents.read by default.
refreshBefore - how long before its expiry a cached access token is renewed, PT60S by default.
dpop - whether tokens are bound to a proof-of-possession key (RFC 9449).
sslBundle - name of the Spring Boot SSL bundle that holds the client certificate and the trust material; needed by the mutual TLS methods (it is also used for the calls to the resource server), and used by the other methods only when set.
@ConfigurationProperties(prefix="service-client.auth") public record ServiceClientAuthProperties(AuthMethod method, String clientId, String clientSecret, URI tokenUri, List<String> scopes, Duration refreshBefore, boolean dpop, String sslBundle) extends Record
Settings of the service client at the authorization server (service-client.auth.*). Every one has a default so that the application starts under any profile; the CLI profiles supply the real values.
